translationRepairs: After returning to the capital he was appointed Grand Secretary of the Titren Hall.
After returning to the capital he was appointed Grand Secretary of the Tiren Hall.

s0017 has 拜體仁閣大學士. 體仁閣 is Tiren Hall; "Titren" is a typographical corruption with no source support. The proposed replacement corrects only that hall name and leaves the rest of the accurate idiomatic wording intact.
After returning to the capital he was appointed Grand Secretary of the Titren Hall.
After returning to the capital he was appointed Grand Secretary of the Tiren Hall.
The same focus unit 還京，拜體仁閣大學士 is mistranslated in the literal field as Titren Hall. Tiren Hall correctly romanizes 體仁閣; the rest of the literal sentence already matches the Chinese.

He also impeached Prince Su Shiduo for monopolizing Grand Council affairs, hoarding power, and taking bribes; when war began Shiduo relied entirely on Hongzhang and thereby mishandled military timing. None of these memorials received a response.

He also impeached Prince Li Shiduo for monopolizing Grand Council affairs, hoarding power, and taking bribes; when war began Shiduo relied entirely on Hongzhang and thereby mishandled military timing. None of these memorials received a response.
s0042 names 禮親王世鐸. 禮親王 is Prince Li; Prince Su would be 肅親王, which is not in the text. Changing Su to Li restores the correct princely title without altering the impeachment charges or outcome.
Baixi memorialized that Wu Jilun, prefect of Jizhou, be given fifth-rank minister status and made general instructor of the university.
Baixi memorialized that Wu Rulun, prefect of Jizhou, be given fifth-rank minister status and made general instructor of the university.
s0057 has 冀州知州吳汝綸. 汝綸 is Rulun, not Jilun; the proposed idiomatic restores the standard personal name while preserving the prefecture, honor, and university-instructor content.
At that time an edict directed all ministers to take turns lecturing before the throne. Jianai composed lectures on the Four Books of the Book of Documents and presented them.
At that time an edict directed all ministers to take turns lecturing before the throne. Jianai composed lectures on the Book of Documents and the Four Books and presented them.

s0023 has 尚書四子書講義: 尚書 (Book of Documents) and 四子書 (the Four Books) are coordinated titles, not "Four Books of the Book of Documents." The proposed literal matches that reading and the already-correct idiomatic.
